shots.scenario: Bubbles sits upright in his crib at 3 PM, arms crossed, glaring into the camera while an adult hand reaches in to pull the curtain closed.
dialogue: Absolutely not. I have meetings.

shots.scenario: Bubbles drags a toy laptop onto the crib rail, taps it hard with two fingers, then yawns mid-tap and blinks slowly.
dialogue: Circle back after my nap.

shots.scenario: Bubbles collapses face first onto the pillow, instantly asleep, one hand still resting on the open toy laptop.
dialogue: Meeting adjourned. Productivity peaked at three oh two.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a shopping cart seat and grabs a cookie box off a low shelf as the cart rolls past, while the adult pushing it reads a label with their face turned away.
dialogue: Phase one: distraction. Mom is reading ingredients.

shots.scenario: Bubbles tucks the cookie box under his blanket, eyes darting left, then right, face perfectly innocent.
dialogue: Phase two: conceal. Say nothing. Look adorable.

shots.scenario: At a checkout belt Bubbles stares straight into the camera with the cookie box in plain view in front of him.
dialogue: I regret nothing.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on a living room floor pointing at a golden retriever lying nearby chewing a baby toy, then looks into the camera, deadpan.
dialogue: That is my toy. Return it.

shots.scenario: The dog slowly nudges the toy across the floor toward Bubbles with its nose; Bubbles picks it up and nods once, facing the camera.
dialogue: Pleasure doing business.

shots.scenario: Bubbles hands the dog a tiny cracker, which it catches gently, then the dog rests its head on his knee.
dialogue: Negotiations like this are why he runs the house.

shots.scenario: Close on Bubbles in a high chair as a spoon of green mush approaches; he holds up one palm like a stop sign and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Hard pass.

shots.scenario: Bubbles slowly slides the bowl toward the edge of the tray, holding eye contact with the camera, and nudges it off.
dialogue: This is not a tantrum. This is a performance review.

shots.scenario: Bubbles looks calmly into the camera with a clean tray in front of him.
dialogue: Next.

hook_text: The only meeting nobody can reach

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a bubble bath wearing a foam beard, arms spread along the tub edge like a boss, steam rising.
dialogue: Bath time. The only meeting where nobody can reach me.

shots.scenario: A yellow rubber duck bobs into frame; Bubbles looks at it with tired patience and then into the camera.
dialogue: Not now, Gerald.

shots.scenario: Bubbles reaches down and pulls the drain plug, the foam beard slowly deflating as he stares ahead calmly.
dialogue: Resignation accepted.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands holding a hallway mirror frame, staring at his own reflection, leaning in slowly, then looks into the camera.
dialogue: Who is that handsome baby?

shots.scenario: Bubbles leans closer until his nose nearly touches the mirror and squints, facing the camera.
dialogue: Looks like management material.

shots.scenario: Bubbles kisses his reflection, leaving a smudge on the glass, and gives a thumbs up to the camera.
dialogue: Self approval at an all time high.

shots.scenario: Bubbles rides in a stroller toward an airport x-ray conveyor while a gloved security hand holds out a gray bin.
dialogue: Security wants to know if he has any liquids.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds up a half-full milk bottle to the camera with both hands.
dialogue: Just milk. Take it up with Mom.

shots.scenario: Bubbles passes through the metal detector in his dad's arms; nothing beeps; Bubbles gives a tiny salute.
dialogue: Cleared. As always.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands in a bedroom in a pumpkin costume with his arms stuck out sideways, staring unimpressed into the camera.
dialogue: I did not approve this costume.

shots.scenario: Bubbles tries to waddle forward and the pumpkin costume spins him slowly in place; he looks into the camera.
dialogue: Who designed this?

shots.scenario: A hand holds out a candy bucket; Bubbles takes the entire bucket instead of one candy and waddles away.
dialogue: Trick or treat? He chose the whole bucket.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands on a doorstep at dusk holding an orange pumpkin bucket, looking into the camera with a serious face while a porch light glows.
dialogue: Full-size bars only. I know what you have.

shots.scenario: A hand drops a tiny candy in the bucket; Bubbles looks down at it, then back to the camera, disappointed.
dialogue: That is a fun size insult.

shots.scenario: Bubbles turns and waddles back down the steps with his bucket, shaking his head.
dialogue: The house is now on his list. Permanently.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a desk before a laptop showing a video call with small adult faces mouthing words silently, and raises one calm hand to the camera.
dialogue: You are on mute.

shots.scenario: Bubbles leans closer to the camera while the faces on the laptop keep mouthing silently.
dialogue: Still on mute.

shots.scenario: Bubbles quietly closes the laptop and leans back with a satisfied sigh.
dialogue: Best meeting of the year.

shots.scenario: A green night-vision baby monitor view of Bubbles standing in his crib at 2 AM, staring straight into the camera from the dark.
dialogue: I know you are watching.

shots.scenario: Night-vision view: Bubbles slowly raises one finger and points at the camera.
dialogue: Come in. We need to talk.

shots.scenario: Night-vision view: Bubbles lies down and pulls up a blanket, eyes still open, staring at the camera.
dialogue: He has never slept through the night. On purpose.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits behind a tiny wooden table with a pitcher of lemonade on a sunny sidewalk, hands folded, looking into the camera.
dialogue: Lemonade. Ten dollars. No refunds.

shots.scenario: A passerby hand holds out a single dollar coin; Bubbles stares at it as if it insulted him, then at the camera.
dialogue: That is an insult.

shots.scenario: Bubbles drinks straight from the pitcher with both hands while the customer walks away.
dialogue: Profit margin: him.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a table in front of a small birthday cake with one candle, adult hands clapping around him, and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Quarterly earnings are in.

shots.scenario: Bubbles raises one hand slowly over the cake, looking at the camera.
dialogue: Brace for impact.

shots.scenario: Bubbles smashes the cake with a splat; frosting covers his blazer and cheeks; he grins proudly into the camera.
dialogue: Earnings beat expectations.

shots.scenario: An elderly woman's hands reach toward Bubbles cheeks while he sits in an armchair; Bubbles raises one hand to block and looks into the camera, deadpan.
dialogue: Cheek pinching is billed per pinch.

shots.scenario: Bubbles pulls out a tiny toy calculator and taps it, still serious, facing the camera.
dialogue: That is four pinches. Cash only.

shots.scenario: Grandma happily hands him a cookie; Bubbles accepts it and nods like he has closed a deal.
dialogue: Another satisfied client.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits buckled in a car seat wearing tiny sunglasses, gazing out the window like a movie star while the car moves smoothly.
dialogue: Welcome aboard. Today's flight: Mom Drives Me To Grandma.

shots.scenario: Bubbles lowers his sunglasses slightly with one finger and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Turbulence. Unacceptable.

shots.scenario: Bubbles drops his snack cup and it lands in the footwell; he stares forward in calm despair.
dialogue: Crew has been notified. Nobody is coming.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands guard behind a pillow fort while a vacuum cleaner roars across the room; he narrows his eyes.
dialogue: Day four hundred. The enemy returns.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds a toy spoon like a sword aimed at the vacuum, then looks into the camera.
dialogue: You will not take the Cheerios.

shots.scenario: The vacuum goes quiet; Bubbles stands victorious on the pillow fort with both arms raised.
dialogue: Peace has been restored. Until Thursday.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a high chair staring at a dark tablet, calm but tense, then looks into the camera.
dialogue: The Wi-Fi is down.

shots.scenario: Bubbles slowly shakes his head, facing the camera.
dialogue: Somebody is getting fired.

shots.scenario: Bubbles taps the dark tablet again and again, tongue out, increasingly intense.
dialogue: Have you tried turning it off and on again? He has. Eleven times.

shots.scenario: A medium close-up of Bubbles in a stroller moving along a sidewalk, his eyes following a jogger passing in the background.
dialogue: Look at this guy. Running. Voluntarily.

shots.scenario: Bubbles watches a man walking three dogs with tangled leashes, one eyebrow raised.
dialogue: Amateur. Never keep leashes loose in front of management.

shots.scenario: Bubbles turns to the camera, serious.
dialogue: I am walking now. In my head.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands in an office elevator holding a tiny briefcase with adult legs around him as the doors close.
dialogue: Elevator pitch. Thirty seconds. Don't waste them.

shots.scenario: Bubbles looks up at an off-screen adult, then at the camera, deadpan.
dialogue: I will cut to the chase. I want your fries.

shots.scenario: The elevator door opens; an adult hand gives Bubbles a small paper bag; he walks out holding it.
dialogue: Closed the deal.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a toy desk wearing a tiny phone headset, tired but polite, looking into the camera.
dialogue: Thank you for calling Teething Support.

shots.scenario: Bubbles listens to the headset, nodding slowly with a straight face, then looks into the camera.
dialogue: Press one to cry. Press two to cry louder.

shots.scenario: Bubbles chews on the headset microphone and closes his eyes in pure bliss.
dialogue: Your call is very important. Please hold. Forever.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on a booster seat in a barbershop chair wrapped in a cape, scissors approaching from the side, and looks into the mirror and camera.
dialogue: Just a trim.

shots.scenario: A single curl falls onto the cape; Bubbles stares at it in horror, then at the camera.
dialogue: That was one curl.

shots.scenario: Bubbles hops down from the chair with perfect hair and drops a tiny coin on the counter.
dialogue: Five stars. Will return in six months.

shots.scenario: An adult hides behind a blanket and pops out; Bubbles stares expressionless from a chair, then looks into the camera.
dialogue: Again? We did this yesterday.

shots.scenario: The adult pops out again; Bubbles sighs and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Do you have anything new?

shots.scenario: The adult pops out wearing a silly hat; Bubbles bursts into delighted laughter and claps.
dialogue: The hat. Always the hat.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a desk with a stack of crayon drawings and a tiny rubber stamp, looking into the camera.
dialogue: Expense report. All receipts attached.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds up one crayon scribble to the camera, serious.
dialogue: This is the receipt for snacks.

shots.scenario: A hand takes the crayon drawings and looks at them, confused; Bubbles sips from a sippy cup.
dialogue: Approved. Obviously.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands holding a coffee table edge while an adult kneels five steps away with open arms.
dialogue: He can walk. He just doesn't want to.

shots.scenario: Bubbles lets go and takes three wobbly steps toward the adult, then stops and looks into the camera.
dialogue: That was a demonstration.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on the carpet satisfied while the adult cheers; he waves them off with one hand like a celebrity.
dialogue: No encore. Please respect his privacy.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits behind a desk interviewing an adult candidate seen only from behind, holding a crayon like a pen, and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Where do you see yourself in five years?

shots.scenario: The candidate hesitates; Bubbles raises one eyebrow, facing the camera.
dialogue: Preferably not here.

shots.scenario: Bubbles slides a paper across the desk with a rubber stamp, expression unreadable.
dialogue: Hired. He needed someone to carry him.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a small table across from a smaller toddler whose hands hold a cracker; Bubbles holds two raisins and looks into the camera.
dialogue: One cracker for two raisins. Final offer.

shots.scenario: Bubbles pulls the cracker closer and narrows his eyes at the camera.
dialogue: You drive a hard bargain.

shots.scenario: Bubbles eats the cracker and the raisins together, smiling.
dialogue: Negotiations concluded. He won again.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a tiny podcast table holding a banana like a microphone and looks into the camera.
dialogue: Welcome back. Today's guest is this banana.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds the banana toward himself, then back, deadpan.
dialogue: Banana, what is your five year plan?

shots.scenario: Bubbles stares at the silent banana, then takes a bite of it.
dialogue: The banana declined to comment. It is evidence now.

hook_text: Go back to sleep. You look tired

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands in a crib holding the rail, looking at a tired adult sitting on the floor outside the crib, half asleep, then at the camera.
dialogue: Go back to sleep. You look tired.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds out a pacifier toward the adult, facing the camera.
dialogue: Take this. You need it more.

shots.scenario: The adult falls asleep sitting up; Bubbles tosses a tiny blanket toward them and sits back satisfied.
dialogue: Parenting is a team sport. He carries.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits behind a tall wooden judge bench holding a toy gavel, a bowl of peas in front of him, looking into the camera.
dialogue: Order in the court.

shots.scenario: Bubbles points the gavel at the bowl of peas, facing the camera.
dialogue: Peas. You are charged with being green.

shots.scenario: Bubbles bangs the gavel and slides the bowl off the bench; it lands softly out of frame.
dialogue: Guilty. Sentence: floor.
